events.text: Ioan ap Gruffudd licensed to crenellate; founded stone castle and tower house.

events.text: George Hay Dawkins-Pennant inherited Penrhyn Estate on 1st Baron's death.
Construction of the present building began to designs by Thomas Hopper.

evidence.quote: The present building was built between about 1822 and 1837

events.text: Construction of the present building completed to designs by Thomas Hopper.

events.text: Edward Gordon Douglas inherited the estate on George's death.

events.label: royal visit
events.text: Queen Victoria visited; a slate bed was made for her.

evidence.quote: a one-ton slate bed made for Queen Victoria when she visited in 1859

events.text: Castle and estate passed to niece Lady Janet Pelham after the 4th Baron's death.

evidence.quote: The 4th Baron Penrhyn died in June 1949 , and the castle and estate passed to his niece

events.text: Castle accepted by the treasury for death duties; later bequeathed to the National Trust.

evidence.quote: In 1951 , the castle and 40,000 acres ( 160 km ) of land were accepted by the treasury
